correctness.rationale: Every cycle in this two-reversal bipartite orientation uses both reverse arcs and equals the unique cross-edge four-cycle. Deleting the first reversal yields a cone on the second. Its link excludes exactly those faces containing the three-edge path sigma. Excision identifies the quotient with a 2-simplex joined with the residual matching complex, modulo its boundary join; the cofiber is precisely a threefold suspension integrally. Finite enumeration independently passed 457 cycle-bearing graphs and 100 cross-edge-deficient graphs; 435 of the former also passed GF(2) homology comparisons. For K7,7 the known H_2(M5,5)=Z/3 supplies the exact H_5 torsion.

value.rationale: The exact two-arc reversal threshold and threefold-suspension equivalence transfer unrestricted residual matching-complex homotopy, including integral torsion, into a nearly acyclic directed complex.
